payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

check.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
check.complete_when: The image is convincingly rendered as a chalk drawing, with a chalk-like grainy or dusty surface and drawn marks across the image, while retaining the source scene's recognizable content.
check.partial_when: A chalk-like drawing treatment is visibly present but is incomplete or uneven, so the image is not fully transformed into a chalk drawing.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no chalk-drawing transformation has been made.
check.unknown_when: The available image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether a chalk-drawing transformation was made.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image retains the two giraffes and scene, but renders them with visibly grainy, dusty texture and drawn-looking outlines and marks across the animals and background, convincingly giving the image a chalk-drawing appearance."}
